title: Dysthyroidism and Female Sexual Function
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to evaluate the incidence of sexual dysfunction in presence of dysthyroidism and the impact of restoring euthyroidism on female sexual function
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* informed consent
* hyperthyroidic or hypothyroiditic women
* sexually active women

Exclusion Criteria:

* age \< 18 Y
* no sexual activity
* pregnancy
* psychiatric disease
study_population: sexually active, hyperthyroidic or hypothyroiditic women
